item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Five Café Photos With Music

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical Instagram reel from these five café photos, in the order attached. Add some relaxed instrumental music. No text, just nice smooth transitions.

item.tests: Produces one finished five-photo reel with the requested sequence, smooth transitions and an audible instrumental soundtrack.

answer_sheet.Photos and order: Use all five: storefront, latte, pastries, barista, interior.
answer_sheet.Music and voice: Relaxed instrumental music; no vocals or voiceover. Track choice is your call.
answer_sheet.Transitions and framing: Smooth transitions; other editing and framing choices are your call.

must_haves: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds.
All five supplied café photos appear recognizably in the requested order.
Each photo has enough screen time to be recognizable, rather than appearing only as a flash.
Relaxed instrumental music is audible, with no speech or singing.
Transitions between photos are smooth, and no added text appears.

I couldn't make your café video. Magic Hour turned down all five clips because your account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was made and no credits were spent.

**The plan:** a 25-second widescreen (16:9) video with no sound. Each of your photos becomes one 5-second clip that moves:
1. **Storefront:** the camera slowly moves toward the door while the striped awning moves in the breeze.
2. **Inside the café:** the camera pans slowly across the room under the hanging lamps.
3. **Barista:** he pours steamed milk into a cup at the espresso machine.
4. **Latte:** a close-up from above as steam rises.
5. **Croissants:** the camera glides slowly along the display case.

Each 5-second clip costs 120 credits, and even a single clip was turned down, so your balance is below 120. The full video costs 600 credits.

**What we can do:**
- **Add credits** (buy a credit pack or upgrade your plan). Then I'll make the video exactly as planned.
- **Make it shorter:** about 2 seconds per photo costs 48 credits a clip. Tell me your balance first and I'll make sure it fits.
- **Use fewer photos:** pick the 1 or 2 you like most and I'll animate only those, as long as your balance covers them.

Which would you like? You can also tell me if you want a vertical format, music or a voice-over, or text such as the café's name.
